summary: Recent coverage highlights concerns about federal control over D.C.'s security forces and renewed commitments to advancing statehood among some lawmakers. The articles underscore advocacy arguments that D.C.'s lack of local autonomy over key institutions creates ongoing governance challenges. Without statehood, D.C. does not control its own National Guard and cannot refuse the deployment of other states' troops within its borders.

articles.title: Why we shouldn’t have National Guard Troops in D.C.
